title: Sports Illustrated April 14, 1986 Cover: Wade Boggs - Here Comes The Hitters
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Vintage Sports Memorabilia:Publications:Magazines
descriptionText: The product is a vintage Sports Illustrated magazine from April 14, 1986 featuring Boston Red Sox baseball player Wade Boggs on the cover. The magazine is an original weekly publication in English, focusing on sports and outdoors subject matter. This collectible item is a great piece of sports memorabilia for fans of Wade Boggs and the Boston Red Sox, capturing a significant moment in baseball history in 1986.
